Died 15 Jul 2003 at Millsboro; buried 19 Jul 2003 in Harmony Cemetery, Millsboro. Son of Samuel Jackson and Agnes Beatrice Wright. Jackson Jr., Kevin W. Jackson, and Horace K. Jackson Sr.
